arxiv-1908-07718.title: On card guessing game with one time riffle shuffle and complete feedback
arxiv-1908-07718.creator: Pengda Liu
arxiv-1908-07718.description: Abstract . This paper studies the game of guessing riffle-shuffled cards with complete feedback. A deck of n n cards labelled 1 to n n is riffle-shuffled once and placed on a table. A player tries to guess the cards from top and is given complete feedback after each guess.

arxiv-2109-09323.title: A Shadowcasting-Based Next-Best-View Planner for Autonomous 3D Exploration
arxiv-2109-09323.creator: Ana Batinovic, Antun Ivanovic, Tamara Petrovic, Stjepan Bogdan
arxiv-2109-09323.description: Abstract In this paper, we address the problem of autonomous exploration of unknown environments with an aerial robot equipped with a sensory set that produces large point clouds, such as LiDARs. The main goal is to gradually explore an area while planning paths and calculating information gain in short computation time, suitable for implementation on an on-board computer.

arxiv-2210-02503.title: The effect of wing-tip vortices on the flow around a NACA0012 wing
arxiv-2210-02503.creator: S. Toosi 1 , A. Peplinski 1,2 , P. Schlatter 1,2 , R. Vinuesa 1,2, 1 FLOW, Engineering Mechanics, KTH Royal Institute of Technology, Sweden 2 Swedish e-Science Research Centre (SeRC), Stockholm, Sweden siavasht@kth.se
arxiv-2210-02503.description: Abstract 1 Introduction There are two basic contributions to the total drag of an airplane [ 1 ] : (i) parasite drag, which consists of friction drag, form drag, and interference drag, and (ii) induced drag (vortex drag, or drag due to lift), which is caused by lift generation in finite-span wings and the consequent presence of wing-tip vortices.

arxiv-2312-02005.title: Remote sensing of backward reflection from stimulated axion decay
arxiv-2312-02005.creator: Kensuke Homma
arxiv-2312-02005.description: Abstract We propose a method for remotely detecting backward reflection via induced decay of cold dark matter such as axion in the background of a propagating coherent photon field. This method can be particularly useful for probing concentrated dark matter streams by Earth’s gravitational lensing effect.

arxiv-2411-19724.title: Zacharie
arxiv-2411-19724.creator: Ales
arxiv-2411-19724.description: Abstract A rounding and clustering-based exact algorithm for the p-center problem Abstract The p -center problem consists in selecting p facilities from a set of possible sites and allocating a set of clients to them in such a way that the maximum distance between a client and the facility to which it is allocated is minimized.

arxiv-2501-06546.title: Natural Language Supervision for Low-light Image Enhancement
arxiv-2501-06546.creator: Jiahui Tang, Kaihua Zhou, Zhijian Luo and Yueen Hou
arxiv-2501-06546.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jiahui Tang, Kaihua Zhou, Zhijian Luo and Yueen Hou. With the development of deep learning, numerous methods for low-light image enhancement (LLIE) have demonstrated remarkable performance. Mainstream LLIE methods typically learn an end-to-end mapping based on pairs of low-light and normal-light images. However, normal-light images under varying illumination conditions serve as reference images, making it difficult to define a “perfect” reference image This leads to the challenge of reconciling metric-oriented and visual-friendly results.

arxiv-2504-14452.title: ParaPO: Aligning Language Models to Reduce Verbatim Reproduction of Pre-training Data
arxiv-2504-14452.creator: Tong Chen ♡ Faeze Brahman ♠ Jiacheng Liu ♡ Niloofar Mireshghallah ♡ Weijia Shi ♡
arxiv-2504-14452.description: Abstract Language models (LMs) can memorize and reproduce segments from their pretraining data verbatim even in non-adversarial settings, raising concerns about copyright, plagiarism, privacy, and creativity. We introduce Paraphrase Preference Optimization (ParaPO), a post-training method that fine-tunes LMs to reduce unintentional regurgitation while preserving their overall utility.

arxiv-2505-19928.title: CA3D: Convolutional-Attentional 3D Nets for Efficient Video Activity Recognition on the Edge
arxiv-2505-19928.creator: Gabriele Lagani, Fabrizio Falchi, Claudio Gennaro, Giuseppe Amato
arxiv-2505-19928.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce a deep learning solution for video activity recognition that leverages an innovative combination of convolutional layers with a linear-complexity attention mechanism. Moreover, we introduce a novel quantization mechanism to further improve the efficiency of our model during both training and inference.

arxiv-2602-02771.title: Markov Random Fields: Structural Properties, Phase Transition, and Response Function Analysis calder@austin.utexas.edu
arxiv-2602-02771.creator: J. Brandon Carter
arxiv-2602-02771.description: Abstract This paper presents a focused review of Markov random fields (MRFs)–commonly used probabilistic representations of spatial dependence in discrete spatial domains–for categorical data, with an emphasis on models for binary-valued observations or latent variables. We examine core structural properties of these models, including clique factorization, conditional independence, and the role of neighborhood structures.

pmc-10529555.title: Traditional surveys versus ecological momentary assessments: Digital citizen science approaches to improve ethical physical activity surveillance among youth
pmc-10529555.creator: Sheriff Tolulope Ibrahim, Nour Hammami, Tarun Reddy Katapally
pmc-10529555.description: The role of physical activity (PA) in minimizing non-communicable diseases is well established. Measurement bias can be reduced via ecological momentary assessments (EMAs) deployed via citizen-owned smartphones. This study aims to engage citizen scientists to understand how PA reported digitally by retrospective and prospective measures varies within the same cohort.

pmc-10696866.title: Circular RNA circATP9A promotes non-small cell lung cancer progression by interacting with HuR and by promoting extracellular vesicles-mediated macrophage M2 polarization
pmc-10696866.creator: Yuanshan Yao, Chunji Chen, Jing Wang, Haojie Xuan, Xiuxiu Chen, Zheng Li, Fuzhi Yang, Bin Wang, Siyun Lin, Saitian Li, Dongfang Tang, Libao Gong, Wen Gao
pmc-10696866.description: BackgroundCircRNA is recognized for its significant regulatory function across various cancers. However, its regulatory role in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is still largely uncharted.MethodsAnalysis based on public databases is completed using R software. circATP9A was identified by two circRNA datasets of NSCLC from the Gene Expression Omnibus database.

A comprehensive understanding of its food preference can help guide mass rearing and safety management during field application of pest control. Although some studies have paid attentions to the impacts of prey shift on C.

pmc-11625292.title: Altered m6A RNA methylation profiles in depression implicate the dysregulation of discrete cellular functions in males and females
pmc-11625292.creator: Haruka Mitsuhashi, Rixing Lin, Anjali Chawla, Naguib Mechawar, Corina Nagy, Gustavo Turecki
pmc-11625292.description: SummaryAdverse environmental stress represents a significant risk factor for major depressive disorder (MDD), often resulting in disrupted synaptic connectivity which is known to be partly regulated by epigenetic mechanisms. N6-methyladenosine (m6A), an epitranscriptomic modification, has emerged as a crucial regulator of activity-dependent gene regulation.

pmc-12538757.title: Global, regional, and national burden of asthma from 1990 to 2021: analysis of data from global disease burden in 2021
pmc-12538757.creator: Cong Hu, Shuxiong Nong, Yixin Chen, Lin Zhang, Yongfeng Chen, Chenang Liu, Ping Li, Chilin Liao, Meng Wu
pmc-12538757.description: BackgroundAsthma is one of the diseases that pose a serious threat to human health globally. The Global Burden of Disease (GBD) study from 1990 to 2021 conducted a comprehensive assessment of the prevalence, incidence, mortality, and Disability-Adjusted Life Years (DALY) of asthma.

pmc-12552182.title: Clinical characteristics analysis and prediction model construction for pediatric influenza virus pneumonia complicated by bacterial infection
pmc-12552182.creator: Xiaofei Xie, Wei Wang, Zhimei Liu, Ting Sun, Yongfu Song, Na Wang, Zhuang Wang, Yongji Wang
pmc-12552182.description: BackgroundBacterial co-infection substantially worsens the clinical course and outcomes of pediatric influenza virus pneumonia, yet early recognition is difficult at presentation. We aimed to (I) characterize the clinical features associated with bacterial co-infection and (II) develop and validate a pragmatic prediction model for bedside risk estimation in children with influenza virus pneumonia.

pmc-12664025.title: Cardiac Damage Staging, Moderate Aortic Stenosis, and the Impact of Aortic Valve Replacement
pmc-12664025.creator: Evan K. Harmon, Travis Howard, Larisa G. Tereshchenko, Amar Krishnaswamy, Grant W. Reed, Elizabeth Ghandakly, James J.Y. Yun, Marijan Koprivanac, Ankur Kalra, Serge C. Harb, Samir R. Kapadia, Rishi Puri
pmc-12664025.description: BackgroundCardiac damage stage predicts clinical outcomes in severe aortic stenosis (AS), yet its validation in moderate AS and natural history preaortic valve replacement (AVR) and post-AVR is poorly understood.ObjectivesThis paper sought to: 1) determine whether index cardiac damage stage predicts cardiovascular outcomes in patients with moderate AS; and 2) describe the impact of AVR on cardiac damage stage over time.

pmc-13330798.title: 1,1′-(2,2-Di­phenyl­ethene-1,1-di­yl)bis­(3,5-dimethyl-1H-pyrazol-2-ium) dichloride
pmc-13330798.creator: Anke Schwarzer, Uwe Böhme
pmc-13330798.description: The title compound crystallizes in the triclinic space group P1. The ethene derivative is substituted by two phenyl groups in 2-position and two 3,5-di­methyl­pyrazolinium units in 1-position, which makes this alkene into a dication. Two chloride ions act as counter-ions in the crystal structure and are linked via N—H⋯Cl and C—H⋯Cl inter­actions with the alkene.

pmc-13575768.title: Efficacy and Safety of Co‐Ablation Combined With Aintilimab for Metastatic Melanoma to the Liver (CryoCheck‐001): A Phase II Trial
pmc-13575768.creator: Lujun Shen, Letao Lin, Shuanggang Chen, Chen Li, Ruizhi Tang, Lin Xie, Yujia Wang, Yunpeng Li, Hongliang Zou, Dandan Li, Xiaoshi Zhang, Weijun Fan
pmc-13575768.description: Liver metastasis is a key driver of immune tolerance in melanoma, limiting immune checkpoint inhibitor efficacy. This prospective single‐arm phase II trial investigated the efficacy and safety of co‐ablation combined with sintilimab for liver‐metastatic melanoma (ChiCTR2200061591). Eligible patients received sintilimab (anti‐PD‐1, 200 mg every 3 weeks) for up to eight cycles alongside co‐ablation.

pmc-13651671.title: Beyond forest plots: trial sequential analysis of magnesium sulfate as an adjuvant in supraclavicular brachial plexus block
pmc-13651671.creator: Willyam Barros Saraiva, Rafael Wanderley Persiano Malta, Roberta Ribeiro Brandão Caldas, Olavo Barbosa de Oliveira-Neto, Fabiano Timbó Barbosa, Célio Fernando de Sousa-Rodrigues
pmc-13651671.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). gesia, particularly when the duration of local anesthetics alone may be insufficient. In this context, magnesium sulfate has been evaluated as a potential adjuvant to local anesthetics.1 Although conventional meta-analyses2 have suggested clinically relevant benefits, these conclusions are commonly based on cumulative forest plots, which are vulnerable to random error and inflation of type I error, especially when the number of trials is limited or when repeated significance testing is performed.

pmc-13676108.title: Clavicular tunnel position is associated with reduction loss after arthroscopic coracoclavicular ligament reconstruction: a computed tomography–based analysis
pmc-13676108.creator: Kenta Inagaki, Nobuyasu Ochiai, Yasuhito Sasaki, Seiji Ohtori, Yasuchika Aoki
pmc-13676108.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2027). BackgroundPost-operative reduction loss remains a major concern after arthroscopic coracoclavicular ligament (CCL) reconstruction. Although bone tunnel position has been suggested as a contributing factor, most previous studies have relied on plain radiographs, which are limited in evaluating three-dimensional positioning.
